channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Dreams are not random; your brain rewrites reality while you sleep
item.description: A large study of over 3,700 dream and waking reports shows that dreams are shaped by our experiences, not random noise.

item.title: NASA astronaut returns after 241 days in orbit
item.description: NASA astronaut Chris Williams and two Roscosmos cosmonauts have returned to Earth after 241 days on the ISS.

item.title: Why Jupiter has several giant moons but Saturn has only Titan
item.description: Jupiter's strong magnetic field may have shielded large moons from destruction, while Saturn lacked similar protection.

item.title: 500,000-year-old elephant bone hammer shows ancient humans were master toolmakers
item.description: A rare elephant bone hammer from nearly 500,000 years ago reveals early humans in England were skilled toolmakers.
